what: Desktop OS windows — on open they pop out from .94× with .3s back.out(1.5) and are placed in a 28px cascade from the screen center (back to the start every five). On close they shrink to .97× (.2s power2.in), on minimize to .9× (.25s) while disappearing. Dragging the title bar follows only until 12px inside the screen, and if the title bar is off-screen on release it is pushed back over .3s power2.out. The clicked window comes to the front and Esc closes the front window

options.ease: Opening curve, default back.out(1.5) — "0.34,1.56,0.64,1" Even the same figure
options.cascade: Step spacing (px), default 28 — 0 keeps it always centered
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Drag handle (title bar). If none, the whole window
options.fx:open·fx:close·fx:min: Events that icons and menus outside the window send to this element. Sending fx:open to a minimized window returns it to the same spot
options.class fx-open: Attach to the window that should be open from the start
options.to: End scale on close, default .97 — at 1 it only fades
options.ox · oy: Not centered — the top-left corner is placed at screen center − ox, − oy (px) — for Brand it is 176 · 280 (11rem · 17.5rem)
options.fade · fadeEase: Turns on opacity alone with this duration (sec) and curve — if absent, it follows the size
options.bound: If ”none”, items are not kept inside the screen when dropped or dragged

use: <section data-fx="desk-window" class="win"><header data-fx-part="bar"><button data-fx-part="close"></button><button data-fx-part="min"></button>Title</header>…</section>  <button onclick="win.dispatchEvent(new Event('fx:open'))">Open</button>

from.where: index.html [data-window] (burst · file · text · folder windows — shared.js openWin·closeWin·minimizeWin·dragWin)
index.html .e-win (original os-window — opens in place at once (no float), closing fades out over .3s sine.inOut, title bar drag)
from.options: open: 0; from: 1; close: .3; to: 1; shut: sine.inOut; cascade: 0

from.where: index.html .project-window — open scale .97→1 400ms cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1) · opacity 300ms ease, top-left calc(50% − 11rem + 24n)·calc(50% − 17.5rem + 24n), close immediately, Esc closes the front window (open: .4; from: .97; ease: 0.165,0.84,0.44,1; fade: .3; fadeEase: 0.25,0.1,0.25,1; ox: 176; oy: 280; cascade: 24; steps: 99; close: 0; to: 1; bound: none)

note: On phones (no hover) it doesn’t drag and opens at the center with no steps — so pushing on the title bar still moves the page. Window size and look (frame, traffic-light colors) belong to the caller’s css
